label: Lockup — mark + Cowork wordmark
revised_prompt: Horizontal brand lockup for Cowork, an AI collaboration desktop app. Left: a DeepSeek-style flat two-tone navy-and-white capybara icon (stout body, blunt snout, negative-space belly, tiny ear). Right: the word 'Cowork' in a clean geometric sans-serif, medium-bold, navy, optically aligned with the icon. Generous spacing between mark and type. Pure white background, centered, lots of padding. No tagline, no slogan, no extra icons, no 3D, no gradient, no photorealism. Looks like a real SaaS header logo. Ultra high resolution, vector-crisp.
